source: GeoLife GPS Trajectories 1.3, acquired by the researcher under the dataset owner's terms
status: trace-driven modeled economics; not observed bidding or payment response
nested_randomness: three model seeds per window; not independent mobility episodes or participant samples
selection: One seven-day bin in each of six consecutive qualifying calendar months, selected by counts of provider trajectory filenames only, before position filtering or mechanism runs; bins anchored to 2008-01-01 UTC and constrained to >=25 distinct filename users. No outcome-based replacement.

episode_builder.failure_policy: Keep and report any window with no usable post-filter data; do not choose a replacement. Do not silently discard model seeds.

mechanism.config_changes_from_R56: Only episode path and n_providers for the observed position cache; N_mean is unused by the trace loader and simulator, but is updated for config integrity. No response bound, algorithm, matching objective, or budget change.

primary_estimand: For each window and scenario, average over its three model seeds, then show all six window-level fixed-envelope minus frozen-point differences in assignment coverage and qualified coverage, with QoS violation counts/rates for both profiles.
inference: Descriptive across six selected windows. No post-hoc parameter choice, no 0.5% risk certificate, no claim of independent participant populations or real economic responses.
privacy: Raw GeoLife, positions, frozen episodes, coordinates and provider/task/slot logs remain outside this public package; only non-identifying aggregated outcomes may be published.
